summary: Add opt-in relevant-change admission and GitHub author scoping to per-PR mission subscriptions

replay.detail: Existing subscriptions and request/run lineage retain ready-head behavior. New relevant-change requests snapshot their admission and configured authors so later declaration edits do not reinterpret queued work.

schema.detail: SubscriptionSpec adds optional kebab-case admission and authors fields. Absent fields remain omitted, preserving existing declaration hashes. Client contracts and generator templates expose the optional fields.

rules.detail: Relevant-change admission includes draft/closure/reopen transitions and same-head relevant facts, coalesces unstarted requests per PR, and uses mode-specific stale fencing. Native PR observations include body_digest and base_sha without recording raw bodies or adding API reads. Author allowlists match GitHub logins case-insensitively; missing attribution is pending rather than excluded. Batched delivery, owner-message diversion, mentions-only selection and non-PR providers are unsupported with this mode.

compatibility.detail: Omitting admission preserves ready-head behavior and hashes. Explicit ready-heads remains supported. Request/run lineage adds admission only for relevant-changes and authors only when configured.

manual.detail: Opt in with admission relevant-changes in a github.repository per-item mission delivery, optionally adding repeated author entries. Current-open-set backfill and a separate backlog view are not included.

recovery.detail: Durable observations, requests and pinned lineage retain the selected policy across restart and replication. Restore ready-head admission for future requests by removing the opt-in declaration; existing lineage is not reinterpreted.
